title: PM Surya Ghar central subsidy
value: ₹30,000/kW for the first 2 kW, ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW, up to ₹78,000

title: Subsidy needs made-in-India (DCR) panels
value: Domestic manufacture of both cells and modules is required for subsidy; an ALMM listing alone does not prove DCR for the delivered serial numbers.

title: Collateral-free solar loan
value: SBI published floating rates: 5.75% up to ₹2 lakh, 7.90% above up to ₹6 lakh; minimum 10% margin, up to 120 months, nil processing fee. Bank approval required.

title: Phase II subsidy claim deadline
value: Claims for applications already redeemed, inspected or installed must reach MNRE by 30 Nov 2026

title: PM Surya Ghar helpline
value: 15555 (toll-free)

title: Housing societies (RWA/GHS) common areas
value: ₹18,000/kW for common facilities incl. EV charging, up to 500 kW

title: Delhi: ₹0 upfront for homes averaging up to 400 units/month
value: Second amendment notified 17 Sep 2026; Delhi utility-led route assigns installer and redeems subsidy through agency. Check consumer consent and eligibility on official portal.

title: Delhi state top-up
value: Up to ₹26,000/kW on first 3 kW, capped at ₹78,000, also capped by trusteeship bid cost minus PM Surya Ghar assistance; confirm route with DISCOM.

title: Delhi electricity subsidy
value: 0–200 units free; 201–400 units half, up to ₹800

title: Delhi fuel surcharge (FPPAS), June 2026
value: BRPL 17.94%, BYPL 17.43%, TPDDL 18.50% of the energy charge

title: Delhi net-metering timeline
value: Cut from 75 to 25 days; fees waived up to 10 kW

title: Uttar Pradesh state top-up (UPNEDA)
value: UPNEDA: ₹15,000/kW up to ₹30,000 state assistance in addition to central subsidy.

title: Haryana top-up for Antyodaya families
value: Income-linked: up to ₹25,000/kW for incomes up to ₹1.8 lakh, max ₹50,000

title: Typical installed price (seed until enough quotes arrive)
value: ₹55,000–70,000 per kW up to 3 kW, including GST

title: Higher subsidy in hill and North-East states
value: ₹33,000/kW for the first 2 kW, ₹19,800 for the 3rd, up to ₹85,800

title: Rajasthan top-up for free-electricity scheme homes
value: ₹17,000 extra, only for homes in the Mukhyamantri Nishulk Bijli Yojana

title: Assam state top-up
value: ₹15,000/kW for the first 3 kW, up to ₹45,000; APDCL ULA document cites Assam notification of 14 March 2024. Confirm current route and availability.

title: Maharashtra: state support needs official confirmation
value: Central subsidy only; extra for BPL/SC/ST homes under Swayampurna is unconfirmed

title: Gujarat: state top-up unclear
value: Older SURYA Gujarat payments appear retired for homes; ask for the government order

title: Kerala: state support needs official confirmation
value: Central subsidy only; KSEB's Soura runs inside the central scheme
